description: This is a PHP source file defining the UploadFile class, which manages file uploads, including validation, malware scanning, storage, and external API integration within the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: UploadFile
classes.description: A class responsible for handling file uploads, validation, malware scanning, renaming, external API uploading, and file path management within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an UploadFile instance with an optional form field name.

methods.name: set_for_soap
methods.description: Configures the object for SOAP-based file upload.

methods.name: get_url
methods.description: Generates a URL for accessing a document, marked as deprecated.

methods.name: get_upload_url
methods.description: Constructs a URL for downloading a document related to a specific module.

methods.name: tryRename
methods.description: Attempts to rename a file to match a bean ID, used internally.

methods.name: get_file_path
methods.description: Builds a file path URL for accessing the uploaded file, with optional renaming.

methods.name: duplicate_file
methods.description: Duplicates an existing uploaded file, catering for both GUID-based and old-style filenames.

methods.name: get_upload_error
methods.description: Retrieves the error code of the most recent upload attempt.

methods.name: confirm_upload
methods.description: Performs security checks and validates the uploaded file, including malware scanning.

methods.name: getMimeSoap
methods.description: Guesses MIME type for SOAP uploads.

methods.name: getMime
methods.description: Determines MIME type of uploaded files, attempting multiple detection methods.

methods.name: get_stored_file_name
methods.description: Returns the filename used for storage.

methods.name: get_temp_file_location
methods.description: Returns temporary file location.

methods.name: get_uploaded_file_name
methods.description: Returns the original uploaded filename.

methods.name: get_mime_type
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the uploaded file.

methods.name: get_file_contents
methods.description: Fetches the contents of the uploaded file.

methods.name: create_stored_filename
methods.description: Generates a sanitized filename for storage, considering platform specifics.

methods.name: final_move
methods.description: Moves the uploaded file from temporary to permanent storage, associated with a bean ID.

methods.name: upload_doc
methods.description: Uploads the document to an external API if configured.

methods.name: get_upload_path
methods.description: Constructs the upload path with filename, with size constraints.

methods.name: unlink_file
methods.description: Deletes a specified uploaded file.

methods.name: get_upload_dir
methods.description: Returns the upload directory prefix.

methods.name: realpath
methods.description: Resolves the real filesystem path of an uploaded file.

methods.name: relativeName
methods.description: Returns file path relative to uploads directory.
